definitions.explanation: A piece of music made of several shorter movements, such as dances, played in sequence.

examples.japanese: バッハ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{組曲|くみきょく}。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{組曲|くみきょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五|いつ}つ→五つ：02892_itsutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: This suite consists of five pieces.

examples.english: Some suites were made by picking the best-known numbers from a ballet score.
